title: Filtering the sale_items table by numbers · part 7

steps.title: Keep id >= 21
steps.prompt:
Numbers compare with small symbols:
  > bigger   < smaller   = exactly   != not equal
Keep the rows where id is at least 21.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE id >= 21;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Add WHERE after the table name.
The test is id >= 21.
Write: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE id >= 21;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE id >= 21;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE keeps only the rows that pass the test.
